name: session-scan
description: Read, filter, and export coding-agent sessions

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:node: bun run build && SESSION_SCAN_TEST_BUILT=1 bun test test/integration/cli.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:node && bun run test:package
